device.modelDescription: Step module of the ch-packs family: picks the few lines that matter out of one failed CI job's cleaned steps. A pure function of its input: no disk, no network, no state.

actionList.name: extract
actionList.description: Takes one job's steps as ch-step-log-clean returns them and returns the lines that explain the failure, each with its step, its index in that step and its kind: 'exit' (Process completed with exit code N, N > 0), 'error' (##[error] lines, error and exception names, npm/tsc/gcc 'error', FAIL/FAILED, panic:, fatal:, TAP 'not ok', node --test's ✖), 'assert' (an error line that also says Assertion or expected), 'stack' (a Python traceback head and the first two frames after an error) and, when fewer than five lines match, 'tail' (the last fifteen lines of the failing step). The failing step is the one holding the exit line, else the last step with an error line, else null. At most maxLines lines (default 40, at most 200), the failing step's kept first; truncated says whether any were left out.
